observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 139.» (L12) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 42: 10 stands beside the first line of the title.
body L7-L9: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type and centred; the title is in two lines.
body L4: a speck stands at mid height after «locis»; it is not a sign.
body L11: in «subāṭ» the dot under the t is printed joined to the foot of the letter.
body L11, L36: «’l–qarnayn» and «’l–qar-» are printed with a dash longer than the hyphens of the page (5.6 and 6.0 pt against 2.8 to 3.6 pt).
body L21, L28: the o of «Romanorum» and of «Romanos» is printed thin, its sides as broken strokes.
notes_left L4: the day of «I ādhār» is printed as a capital I, without the flag that the figure 1 has in the notes (in the number of note 1 and in the folio of note 2); kept as printed.
notes_left L6, notes_right L6: the letters of «adn. a» and «adn. b» are bold italic.
notes_right L6: a short low stroke stands between «cfr.» and «adn.»; it is not a sign.

notes_right L4-L6: Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (p. XX; AB01-PDF0437-body-L029) say that in this chapter «aera Coptorum» and «anni Coptorum» denote the Egyptian, or vague, years counted from the era of Dhū ’l-qarnayn, as he sets out in Part II, p. 205, and that note 4, which takes the era for that of Augustus, is to be emended accordingly. The note is kept as printed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
